reviews.text: La storia spiegata in modo onesto: un gruppo di uomini vestiti alla moda appartenenti ad una elite privilegiata, deve votare per decidere chi é il loro nuovo capo. Il responsabile delle votazioni ascolta campagne elettorali a favore di vari candidati che elimina sistematicamente grazie a segretucci di cui viene a conoscenza facendo lo Sherlock della situazione. E' chiaro dall'inizio come andrà a finire ma dobbiamo fingere per due ore che non lo sia. Sergio Castellitto é per quasi tutti un villain ideologico. Per chi é questa storia? Per gli uomini a cui é piaciuto The Menu. Per chi non é questa storia? Per le donne che sono pieneh di film noiosi con dinamiche prese in prestito a cult teen che vengono considerati stupidi perché con un target femminile.
il classico film per cui tutti si intrippano tipo the menu ma che alla fine é offensivo dell'intelligenza dello spettator- aspetta un attimo entrambi hanno voldemort come protagonista ADESSO CAPISCO
chato, acho que tinha personagens bons e um cenário com tudo pra dar certo mas deixou tudo meio aberto e sem graça, vi muita gente gostando desse filme mas não achei nada demais sinceramente..

Was wondering if the script got delayed by covid or something but was unsurprised to learn that it was actually an adaptation of a book, written by an English dude in 2016. The acting is obviously great and I like the cinematography but the plot was entirely ridiculous and seemed to miss the mark on making some characters sympathetic or have redeeming qualities.

После смерти Папы Римского кардиналы собираются для выбора нового главы католической церкви. Процесс превращается в настоящую борьбу, ведь у каждого кандидата оказывается свой скелет в шкафу. Зрителя погружают в атмосферу мрачных коридоров Ватикана. Звукорежиссёр позволяет услышать шаги, шёпот и даже дыхание героев, что одновременно создаёт напряжение и интимную обстановку для обсуждения вопросов веры. Сохранение традиции или реформа религиозных институтов? Глава церкви - менеджер или пастырь? Может ли он сомневаться? Какие человеческие слабости нельзя в нём принять? Все эти вопросы практически не поднимаются в "Конклаве". Триллер здесь тоже сложно найти. Главный герой узнает тайну одного из кандидатов, делает её публичной, баланс сил на голосовании меняется - и так несколько раз. Тогда зачем это всё нужно? Ответ разочаровывающе банален: фильм является реакцией на выборы в странах Запада. Да, это очередное обсуждение "правых популистов", "левых либералов" и прочих словосочетаний, не вызывающих уже ничего, кроме скуки. Хорошо, фильм хочет говорить про политику, а не про религию. Будет ли здесь показан интересный конфликт идей? Нет. В самом начале зрителю чётко говорят: "Вот правые, они очень плохие. Вот левые, они хорошие, но им чего-то не хватает для победы". Ни аргументов, ни дискуссии здесь не будет. То есть, чтобы сопереживать местной драме, нужно заранее находиться в определённой части политического спектра. Финал фильма, когда зритель узнает, кто и в какой обстановке победил Главного Буржуина, может вызвать только нервный смешок.

Slow first half that builds to a more enjoyable second. The acting and dialogue are so restrained I found it difficult to be invested. Part of that may be my own general disinclination toward religion, but I didn’t feel engrossed by the process or pageantry. The ending is certainly a choice. I see praise for representation and starting a dialogue but that doesn’t make for a compelling story. I think people’s personal politics and identity are clouding their judgment here. It felt disjointed and failed to leave an impactful. No one will watch this and have a revelation. A better movie could have.

Still pissed off at the ending. The first 115 minutes are incredible and tackle issues of faith, ideology, and how politics factor into a decision that should be divinely inspired. The different ways that each favorite for the papacy balances their personal and spiritual ambitions is presented in a thrilling way. The only way to make the ending make any sense within the greater extent of the film is to assume that the true intention all along was an exploration of the role of gender/sex in the church and the arbitrary requirement for priests, etc. to be male. However, if that is the case, the previous length of the movie does a really bad job of setting that up, as in the scenes in which gender comes up it is overshadowed by other events that drive the obvious plot forward. This could have been one of my favorite movies, but unfortunately they flew close to the sun and tried to make one "powerful" statement too many.

I was so excited to see this on opening night. I am the target audience for "Ralph Fiennes in the Vatican." I hated it. The movie looked good, but who gets credit for that? I should think sets and costumes take care of themselves, and your job is merely not to mess it up (which they don’t). Beyond that, there was nothing. The plot generated no suspense whatsoever, and by the end I could not have cared less who became the pope. They could have elected an elephant and I’d barely have looked up from my watch. The movie's version of Catholic politics was a facile caricature. Conflating it with the left-right divide in America is obvious and stupid as well as inaccurate. Having said that, you at least have to hand it to them that they gave the devil his due. Sergio Castellitto as the conservative cardinal Tedesco was the only performance that actually leapt off the screen and made me feel anything. Everyone else was practically comatose. For twisty, silly, sexy, Malkovichy Vatican shenanigans, The Young Pope and The New Pope still take the palm.
This movie feels like seeing a group of girls gossiping and not knowing what it’s about thereby feeling left out. So many unanswered questions. Also, did I just see a bishop vape?!?

I may be out of touch with this Conclave. While I can appreciate Ralph Fiennes as the lead role, and the stylism of the movie, I just cannot get involved with the drama and left it feeling underwhelmed.

Plein de promesses dans son premier acte, le film se perd en choisissant la facilité du soap opéra et une subversivité convenue qui met à mal toute profondeur. Il y avait pourtant tellement à dire de cette institution lourde et anachronique à l'heure de l'immédiat éphémère et des fractures idéo-theologiques extrêmes. Subtilités et nuances s'effacent pour laisser place aux effets faciles, voir grossiers, bien trop contemporains pour faire date. Un joli hors sujet en somme.

"Nos conclaves usamos vermelho" Não assistam esperando grandes dramas e escândalos ou conspirações muito mirabolantes, porque o título é bem auto explicativo, é só um conclave KKKKKKKKKKKKKK Óbvio que tem umas corrupções, mas nada além do que todo mundo sabe que acontece. O enredo é bem monótono, não é um filme emocionante de forma alguma, é do tipo que você assiste sério o tempo todo, no máximo tem umas surpresinhas aqui e ali. O plot é surpreendente, não sei bem o que eu achei dele, mas que foi surpreendente foi. Mas o filme acaba logo depois, coisa que eu pessoalmente não gosto então fica aí a informação pra quem pretende ver. Falando de coisas boas agora, O CONTRASTE DO VERMELHO E DO BRANCO NESSE FILME!!! QUE COISA LINDA!!! A fotografia num geral é belíssima na verdade. O jogo de câmera é muito sagaz, o roteiro é bom, a atuação é do caralho (e o elenco tem que ser mencionado porque além de todos terem atuado bem, simplesmente um dos "padres" é o Voldemort/o Gustave de O Grande Hotel Budapeste e o outro é o Nigel de O Diabo Veste Prada , e eu achei isso o auge). É um filme até interessante de se assistir, mesmo pra quem não é católico (mas, obviamente, eu imagino que pra quem seja o filme seja de mais peso). Agora que padre FOFOQUEIRO esse de roxo SOCORRO, eu amo que ele simplesmente não se aguenta quando descobre um segredo que já se coça todinho pra contar KKKKKKKKKKKKKK, é realmente um meninas malvadas versão homens idosos católicos
